name: Pagination
description: Page numbers with previous and next buttons, for content split across pages. Long ranges collapse to the first page, the last page, and the pages around the current one.

onChange.description: Called with the page the user chose.

siblingCount.description: How many page numbers to show on each side of the current page before collapsing the rest to an ellipsis.

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Translate it for other languages.

keyboard: Enter or Space goes to that page
requirements: A navigation landmark with an accessible name, containing a list of buttons
The current page has aria-current="page" and is also marked by shape and weight, not just color
Each page button is named Page N; previous and next are named Previous page and Next page and are disabled at the ends
After the page changes, move focus or announce the new content: the component only tells you the page
screenReader: Announced as a navigation landmark named Pagination, with a list of items
The current page is announced as the current page, e.g. "Page 3, current page"
A disabled previous button on page 1 is announced as dimmed or unavailable

use_when: Lists or search results split into pages
When people need to jump to a specific page or know how far they are
avoid_when: Endless feeds: use a Load more button
A data grid: it has its own pager
anti_patterns: Changing the content without telling screen readers (move focus to the results heading or announce it)
